$comment: Hand-written metadata for the no-code assets. {url} in a tryPrompt becomes the skill's GitHub link, so the prompt also works where the skill is not installed. Names and descriptions of skills come from each SKILL.md, prompt text from the prompt files; scripts/build_no_code_catalog.py merges all of it into the demo app. Paths are relative to this file.

skills.title: Incident report writing
skills.tagline: Turn a spoken incident or safety observation into a Word report.
setup: Windows only. Needs Python 3.8+ and an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI key. Claude cannot listen to audio, so the recording is transcribed with Whisper first. Already have a transcript? Use the matching prompt instead; it needs no key.
Download the setup kit, unzip it and run setup.bat. It installs the transcriber, saves your key and writes the Claude Desktop config.
Copy the generated claude_desktop_config.json content into %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop.
Upload the skill .zip in Claude: Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the incident-report-writing skill ({url}) to turn my audio recording into an incident report. I will attach the file next.

skills.title: Construction diary creation
skills.tagline: Turn a site manager's spoken day into a Työmaapäiväkirja.
setup: Windows only. Needs Python 3.8+ and an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI key. Claude cannot listen to audio, so the recording is transcribed with Whisper first. Already have a transcript? Use the matching prompt instead; it needs no key.
Download the setup kit, unzip it and run setup.bat. It installs the transcriber, saves your key and writes the Claude Desktop config.
Copy the generated claude_desktop_config.json content into %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop.
Upload the skill .zip in Claude: Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the construction-diary-creation skill ({url}) to create today's Työmaapäiväkirja from my site recording. I will attach the audio next.

skills.title: Purchase order processing
skills.tagline: Match a purchase order and its BOMs against a price list and produce a priced sales order.
skills.input: PO, BOM PDFs and a price list
setup: Needs Node.js. Add the file access server to claude_desktop_config.json as shown in the setup guide, then restart Claude Desktop.
Upload the skill .zip in Claude: Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the purchase-order-processing skill ({url}) to turn my purchase order, its BOMs and the price list into a priced sales order. I will attach the files next.

skills.title: Report writing
skills.tagline: Consolidate recordings, notes and documents into one structured Word report.
setup: Windows only. Needs Python 3.8+, Node.js and an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI key. Claude cannot listen to audio, so recordings are transcribed with Whisper first.
Download the setup kit, unzip it and run setup.bat. It installs the transcriber and the file access server, saves your key and writes the Claude Desktop config.
Copy the generated claude_desktop_config.json content into %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop.
Upload the skill .zip in Claude: Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the report-writing skill ({url}) to write a report from the materials I am about to attach. Infer the sections from the content.

skills.title: Parsing documents
skills.tagline: Pick a parser that keeps table structure, and catch pages that parsed to nothing.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the parsing-documents skill ({url}) to choose a parser for my PDFs and check that the tables came through intact.

skills.title: Extracting structured data
skills.tagline: Design an extraction schema that stays inside provider limits and carries checkable evidence.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the extracting-structured-data skill ({url}) to design a schema for the invoices in this folder and add page and quote evidence to each field.

skills.title: Searching documents
skills.tagline: Build hybrid pgvector and full-text search that fails visibly, including for Finnish text.
skills.tryPrompt: Use the searching-documents skill ({url}) to add hybrid search over my document chunks and measure it with Hit@K.
